description: Render a variant per row, as Variants does: `rows` (objects) or `csv` (a header row, then a row per variant). Each column fills the layer named like it — its text, a counter's end value, a fill color, or a picture by its file name in the scene's media library — or the layer `bindings` maps it to (column → layer id or name). `nameColumn` names each file. Takes every option `export` takes (an image by default; kind video for a clip per row). Without rows, the sheet already set in Variants. Answers with the files and any column that bound to nothing.

options.description: Any other export option: scale, fps, seconds, inSeconds, outSeconds, background, artboard.

name: render_variants
